summary: Iteration 302 - Fleet-wide Coordinate Validation + Auto-Repair Endpoint Testing. Backend: 15/15 tests PASSED (100%). All features verified: dry_run mode, fix mode with coordinate repair, property_ids filter, RBAC (admin/manager required), edge cases (no_coordinates, no_country), reverse_geocode helper, and regression tests for existing endpoints.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped per request - new buttons fleet-validate-geo-btn and fleet-validate-geo-dryrun-btn exist in FleetCompetitorPulseCard.js but not tested

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/revenue/market-robot/fleet-validate-geo correctly implements dry_run (default true) and fix modes
COUNTRY_MAP_FV dictionary correctly maps country names/codes to ISO alpha-2 (UK→gb, US→us, TR→tr, etc.)
reverse_geocode helper in booking_scraper.py correctly returns {country_code, country, city, state, display_name}
Property filter via property_ids array correctly restricts scope to specified IDs
Edge cases handled: no_coordinates → skipped, no_country_on_property → skipped, reverse_geocode_failed → unknown
Fix mode correctly uses country-biased forward geocoding with multiple candidate queries (address+postcode+city, postcode+city, name+city)
Response structure includes ok_count, flagged_count, fixed_count, skipped_count, and per-property results array
Each result entry includes property_id, name, city, country, expected_country_code, before{lat,lon,display}, status, reason, and on success: actual_country_code, actual_city, actual_display
RBAC correctly enforced: admin/manager allowed, receptionist gets 403
Nominatim rate limit respected via sleep_s parameter (default 1.1s, min 0.5s, max 3.0s)
seed_data_creation: Test used existing properties: camden-suites, aldgate-flats, city-rooms (all with valid London coordinates). Fix mode test temporarily corrupted camden-suites to Boston coords and verified repair.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fleet-validate-geo endpoint fully tested. Key test: corrupted camden-suites to Boston (lat=42.34, lon=-71.08) and verified fix=true repaired it back to London (~51.55). Nominatim API has 1 req/sec rate limit - use sleep_s parameter. Properties with coordinates: camden-suites, aldgate-flats, city-rooms. Most other properties have no coordinates and will be skipped.
